description: This source file defines the CatalogTypeListEndpoint class, implementing an API endpoint to list catalog types in the eShopWeb project. It uses dependency injection, routing, and mapping to handle HTTP GET requests for catalog types.

classes.name: CatalogTypeListEndpoint
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint for listing catalog types, handling route registration and request handling.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Registers the GET route 'api/catalog-types' and associates it with the handler that lists catalog types.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves catalog types from the repository, maps them to DTOs, and returns as HTTP response.
